title: A Figure Appears in the Time-Space Rift
next_chapter_hook: The figure in the time-space rift had deep-set eyes that burst forth with astonishing divine light: "Child... the fate you bear is older than the Tianji Record..." The voice seemed to traverse countless eons, carrying an irresistible grief and hope. In the depths of Chen Ji's bloodline, the memory gate sealed for ten thousand years was slowly opening...

text.content: Ling Yuan's figure completely vanished into the depths of that gloomy secret realm, leaving only those whispered words lingering in the air—"Chen Ji... the destiny between us runs deeper than you can imagine." Chen Ji clenched his fists, his knuckles white, fine beads of sweat seeping from his temples. At this moment, he finally realized that the bloodline mystery between himself and the former Tianqing Sect Master was far more complex than he had imagined.\n\nHe took a deep breath, trying to calm his surging heart. But just then—at the core of the secret realm, the originally calm void suddenly twisted violently. A ferocious rift tore open as if by an invisible giant hand, and within the pitch-black crack, eerie silver light flickered.

"This is..." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, instinctively stepping back half a pace. He could clearly sense that the aura emanating from that time-space rift was ancient to the point of suffocation, as if having traversed the endless river of years, carrying a pressure that transcended comprehension.\n\nMore eerily, the Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace suddenly burned scorching hot at this moment, that familiar burning sensation almost scorching through his chest. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's voice rang in his mind, carrying rare gravity: "Be careful... something in that rift wants to come out."

dialogue.content:
"What thing?" Chen Ji demanded in his heart.

But Mo Xiansheng was unusually silent.

Just then, a weak yet hoarse voice came from within the time-space rift—"...Bloodline... my bloodline... you've finally arrived..."

The voice was hoarse and intermittent, as if having waited in endless darkness for far too long.

text.content:
Chen Ji's whole body trembled as if struck by lightning.

"Bloodline?" His voice slightly quivered, "What do you mean?"

In the time-space rift, a blurry figure was slowly coalescing. That figure was hunched, wrapped around by countless pitch-black chains, each chain inscribed with densely packed ancient runes, emanating a heart-stopping sealing power.

Chen Ji stared fixedly at that figure, a strange sense of familiarity welling up from the depths of his bloodline, as if something was desperately trying to break through the ground.

dialogue.content:
"Who are you?" Chen Ji forcibly suppressed his surging emotions, keeping his voice as calm as possible, "Why call me bloodline?"

The imprisoned figure slowly raised its head, revealing a face weathered by countless hardships. Its eye sockets were deep-set, yet burned with flames of obsession. Its gaze toward Chen Ji held both grief and barely containable excitement—

"My name... is... Chen... Tianji..."

Before the words finished, that figure coughed violently, and the pitch-black chains clattered noisily.

text.content:
"Chen Tianji?!" Chen Ji's mind exploded like thunder.

Tianji Record... Chen Tianji...

The connection between these two names made him instantly think of some terrifying possibility. His breathing abruptly grew rapid, the burning sensation in his chest growing ever more intense, as if something was awakening within his bloodline.

Meanwhile, the golden seed that had been dormant in his dantian for so long began to quiver slightly, and some sealed memories surged toward his mind like a tide—

That was a hazy scene: a man holding an infant, standing atop a majestic mountain peak, with countless living beings kneeling in worship below the mountain...

dialogue.content:
"Break... the seal..." the imprisoned figure spoke with great difficulty, every word seeming to exhaust all its strength, "My bloodline... Chen family... the last spark... only you can..."

Its voice grew fainter and fainter, its body becoming ever more transparent. The time-space rift was slowly contracting, as if the passage connecting the two realms was about to close once more.

"Wait!" Chen Ji stepped forward abruptly, "Who are you really? What connection do you have with me? What about Ling Yuan?"

Yet that figure only gazed deeply at him with those eyes burning with obsession, its lips moving, seeming to want to say something, but no longer able to produce any sound.

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out in his mind once more, this time carrying undisguisable shock: "Chen Ji... I understand now... I finally understand..."

"What do you understand?" Chen Ji pressed urgently.

"That figure... if my perception is not mistaken..." Mo Xiansheng's voice slightly trembled, "He is very likely the original owner of the Tianji Record... that is to say... your direct ancestor!"

Chen Ji felt his mind go completely blank.

Original owner? Direct ancestor?

Could the origins of the Tianji Record have such a profound connection to the Chen family's bloodline?

Just then, the time-space rift let out a piercing roar, the speed of contraction suddenly accelerating.

The imprisoned figure used its last strand of strength, raising its hand—that withered palm pierced through the rift, reaching toward Chen Ji's direction. At its palm center, a faint golden light was flickering.

"Child... accept... the ancestor's gift..."

The voice seemed to traverse endless time and space, carrying undeniable authority, yet filled with boundless tenderness.

The time-space rift began to tremble violently, countless tiny cracks spreading through the void, which could shatter completely at any moment.

Chen Ji stared at that withered palm reaching toward him, his heart torn by inner conflict.

If this truly was his ancestor's gift, what a staggering fortune it would be? But what if it was some kind of trap? Ling Yuan had just left, and this time-space rift appeared— wasn't the timing a bit too coincidental?

Moreover, he clearly sensed the turmoil within his bloodline depths. Those sealed memories were awakening, and each awakening brought unpredictable consequences. His Heavenly Fate was already scarce; if it was consumed further...

But that aged voice, those eyes burning with obsession, that inexplicable sense of familiarity...

To give up like this, he could not.

choice.prompt: The time-space rift is about to collapse, the ancestor's gift is within reach— how will you decide?

choices.description: Fully activate the Tianji Record, accept the ancestor's gift, regardless of the cost. The Chen family's destiny should not be met with retreat by him.
choices.visible_cost: May consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the ancestor's gift, may unseal bloodline inheritance
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk, may trigger unpredictable consequences

dialogue.content: "Ancestors above, your unworthy descendant Chen Ji, today bearing the bloodline's summons, no matter how arduous the road ahead, the Chen family's soul shall never be extinguished!"\n\nChen Ji knelt on both knees, touching his forehead to the ground, performing an ancient and solemn kowtow.

text.content:
The words fell, he abruptly raised his head, his eyes blazing with brilliant light. The fragment at his chest burst forth with dazzling golden radiance, echoing from afar with the golden light in that palm.

In that instant, the Tianji Record flew out from his embrace on its own, hovering before Chen Ji. Countless ancient runes peeled off from the fragment, transforming into streams of golden light ribbons, surging toward the figure within the time-space rift—

That was the bloodline inheritance sealed for ten thousand years, awakening!

"BOOM!"

Chen Ji felt a thunderclap explode in his mind, countless chaotic scenes flooding in like a tide—

He saw an infant born, laden with the family's great expectations.

He saw a youth grow up, taking hold of the Tianji Record.

He saw a man standing against the Eye of Heaven to protect all under heaven.

He saw that man defeated, eternally imprisoned in the夹缝 of time and space...

That was his ancestor— Chen Tianji! The true original master of the Tianji Record!

choices.description: Do not rashly accept, first demand the other party clarify the relationship between the Chen family and Ling Yuan, and the truth behind all this. Plan before acting.

dialogue.content:
"Wait!" Chen Ji's voice was deep. "The junior dares to ask, ancestor - what is the relationship between Ling Yuan and the Chen family? Why does he possess the Tianji Record Fragment, yet seek to kill me?"

The imprisoned figure's movements slightly stagnated. The light in his eyes seemed to dim, yet carried a hint of relief.

"Good... good... what a prudent child..." His voice grew increasingly faint. "Ling Yuan... he was originally... a surname outsider disciple of Chen family... chosen by the Tianji Record... yet betrayed..."

Before the words could finish, his body suddenly convulsed. The runes on the chains blazed brightly, seemingly forcibly suppressing something.

text.content:
"Betrayed?" Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly. "What do you mean?"

Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly interjected: "Chen Ji, I understand now! Ling Yuan was once chosen as a candidate by the Tianji Record, but was eliminated due to insufficient heart nature. He then chose you instead. And he... harboring resentment, joined the Eye of Heavenly Dao!"

Within the time-space rift, that figure nodded with difficulty, seemingly confirming this explanation.

"The Eye of... Heavenly Dao..." When he uttered these words, his voice was filled with grief, indignation, and unwillingness. "It has always been... waiting... waiting for the Tianji Record... the most perfect host..."

"And I... am the sacrifice it chose..."

Chen Ji's entire body went cold.

Sacrifice? The Eye of Heavenly Dao?

So all along, he had been prey targeted by the Eye of Heavenly Dao?

That figure seemed to sense his emotional fluctuation. His withered palm reached out again, the golden light in his palm becoming increasingly bright—

"Child... accept the inheritance... only by accepting... can you oppose... Heavenly Dao..."

The time-space rift began to contract again. The time left for him was running out.

choices.description: Stay vigilant, observe the situation first. Ling Yuan just left and this time-space rift appears—too many coincidences, one must be on guard.

text.content:
Chen Ji took a step back, his gaze sweeping the surroundings vigilantly.

Ling Yuan had just left, and this time-space rift appeared immediately—the timing was far too convenient. Moreover, Mo Xiansheng had said the Eye of Heavenly Dao was skilled at scheming. He couldn't help but be wary.

"Forgive me, Ancestor." He slightly bowed, his voice sincere yet distant. "The junior is not unwilling to help, but this matter is too suspicious. I need more time to judge."

Within the time-space rift, that figure's movements suddenly froze.

dialogue.content:
The imprisoned figure fell silent for a moment. Turbid eyes flickered with a complex light—disappointment, understanding, and a hint of approval.

"Good... very good..." His voice became ethereal. "Indeed... the Chen bloodline... possessing both courage... and prudence..."

His palm slowly withdrew, yet the golden light in his palm did not disappear. Instead, it transformed into a tiny golden speck, passing through the time-space rift, drifting toward Chen Ji.

"This is... a drop of ancestor's blood essence... keep it well... when you are ready... come find me again..."

text.content:
That golden speck landed in Chen Ji's palm, warm and gentle, creating a subtle resonance with some force within his bloodline.

At the same time, the time-space rift completely collapsed. Countless fragmented runes danced in the air, then dissipated into nothingness. That aged figure also vanished with it, leaving only an ethereal voice echoing in the air—

"Child... remember... the Eye of Heavenly Dao... is everywhere... every step you take... it watches..."

The final sentence exploded in Chen Ji's mind like thunder—

"Ling Yuan... he has been... completely controlled by the Eye of Heavenly Dao..."

Chen Ji lowered his head, gazing at the drop of golden blood essence in his palm. His heart was filled with countless emotions.

The ancestor's gift, Ling Yuan's conspiracy, the Eye of Heavenly Dao's scheme... everything, everything rushed toward him in this brief moment, nearly suffocating him.

But he did not panic.

Instead, his gaze became unprecedentedly clear. Since he now knew who the enemy was, then every step ahead would have direction.

"The Eye of Heavenly Dao..." he murmured to himself, a cold smile tugging at his lips. "Since you want to use me as a chess piece, let me show you how this piece overturns the entire game."

Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again, carrying a hint of emotion: "Chen Ji, what are your thoughts on today's events?"

Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then slowly spoke: "Thoughts? I only want to say—very good, very good."

His voice was terrifyingly calm: "Ling Yuan is a traitor, the ancestor is the victim, the Eye of Heavenly Dao is the mastermind behind the scenes. I've noted all of this."

He gripped the golden blood essence in his palm, a sharp glint flickering in his eyes: "But I will not act rashly. If the Eye of Heavenly Dao wants me as a chess piece, I will be a piece it can never control. The day I become strong enough, I will overturn this game with my own hands."

Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a long time, finally letting out a soft sigh: "You are more adept at patience than your ancestor... This may be good, or it may be bad."

"Good or bad doesn't matter." Chen Ji said calmly, "This is my way of survival."

He raised his head, gazing toward that dark space deep within the secret realm. The ancestor was imprisoned there, waiting for the day of rescue. And Ling Yuan... that traitor who had joined the Eye of Heavenly Dao...

"Ancestor, wait for me." He silently said in his heart. "The day I become strong enough, I will come to save you. Ling Yuan's debt, we will settle together."

Just then, a commotion of footsteps echoed from outside the secret realm, as if other disciples were approaching.

choice.prompt: Someone is approaching. How will you respond?

choices.description: Walk out boldly. After all, his "waste" persona is deeply ingrained. A waste appearing in the secret realm's inner sect area is very normal.

text.content:
Chen Ji straightened his clothes, switched his face to that usual timid expression, and slowly walked toward the exit of the secret realm.

As expected, after just a few steps, he encountered a patrol team of inner sect disciples. The leader, upon seeing him, a flicker of disdain flashed in his eyes.

"Oh, isn't this the waste Chen Ji? What brings you to the inner sect's secret realm?" The man sneered. "Is this a place you can come?"

Chen Ji shrunk his neck, lowering his voice: "Senior brother... I got lost... accidentally walked in..."

"A waste is a waste, can't even find your way!" The man laughed mockingly and waved his hand. "Get lost, get lost, hurry back!"

Chen Ji nodded and bowed repeatedly, appearing terrified. He turned and left. Only after walking far away did he raise the corner of his mouth, silently smiling.

choices.description: It's not the time to expose oneself. First hide in the shadows and observe who is coming. If it's an enemy, one can also prepare in advance.

text.content:
Chen Ji vanished silently into the shadows.

A moment later, the patrol of disciples passed by the hidden passage entrance. The leader's voice clearly reached his ears—

"Have you heard? The old sect master just went deep into the secret realm, no one knows what he's searching for."

"Hush! Keep your voice down. This isn't something we should discuss." The other person lowered their voice, "But I heard... the old sect master has been very strange lately, seems like he's investigating something secretly."

"Investigating? Investigating who?"

"Who knows... anyway, it's got nothing to do with us. Let's go, let's go, don't be nosy."

The footsteps gradually faded into the distance. Chen Ji stepped out of the shadows, his eyes gleaming with sharp light.

What was Ling Yuan investigating? Was he looking for him? Or was he looking for... the ancestor in the temporal rift?

After leaving the secret realm, Chen Ji did not return directly to the servants' quarters. Instead, he came to a secluded cliff edge.

The night wind blew, lifting a few strands of hair from his forehead. He sat cross-legged, carefully收敛 the golden essence in his palm into his body. The drop of essence, once entering his body, slipped into his bloodline like a swimming fish, merging with his own blood.

In an instant, a warm force surged from the depths of his bloodline, flowing through all four limbs and hundred bones.

He sensed it—deep within his bloodline, those sealed memories were slowly awakening. Though still very vague, he could faintly see some fragmented images...

A majestic palace.

Countless kneeling figures.

And a man, standing on a high platform, holding a scroll of ancient text glowing with golden light—that was the Tianji Record!

dialogue.content:
"So that is... the ancestor?" Chen Ji murmured to himself.

The man in the image was majestic and solemn, emanating an overwhelming royal aura that made one dare not look directly. Back then, he was full of ambition, the one chosen by the Tianji Record, the center of all attention.

However, in the next instant, the scene changed drastically—

Endless darkness surged from the void, completely devouring that figure. Countless black chains wound around from all directions, dragging him into the endless abyss...

"No!"

Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, gasping for breath. His forehead was already covered in cold sweat.

He looked down at his own hands—the warm force still flowed through his bloodline, closely connecting him with that ancestor he had never met.

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded, carrying a hint of solemnity: "That is the scene of Chen Tianji being imprisoned. The methods of the Heavenly Dao's Eye are more terrifying than I imagined."

"Can I save him?" Chen Ji asked.

Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment: "Very difficult. That is a seal personally laid by the Heavenly Dao's Eye, requiring power far beyond ordinary people to break. But..."

"But what?"

"But if you can gather all the fragments of the Tianji Record, restoring its complete power, perhaps... there is a glimmer of hope."

Chen Ji clenched his fists, his eyes burning with determined light: "Then we shall find them. Even if I must traverse the ends of the earth, I will gather the complete Tianji Record and rescue the ancestor!"

His voice echoed in the night sky, carrying unwavering resolve.

At this moment, Chen Ji had a clear goal.

The complete form of the Tianji Record. The rescue of the ancestor. The settlement of accounts with Ling Yuan. And... the Heavenly Dao's Eye hiding behind the scenes.

He did not know how long this road was, how difficult it would be. But he knew that since fate had pushed him to this position, he would not retreat.

"Chen Tianji... ancestor..." He looked up at the starry sky, murmuring, "Wait for me. Your unworthy descendant Chen Ji will someday come to liberate you."

The night wind howled, as if responding to his oath.

And in the distant Nine Heavens, some existence beyond comprehension also seemed to be watching all this—

The Heavenly Dao's Eye slowly opened.

dialogue.content:
"Interesting... after ten thousand years, someone has finally inherited his bloodline..."

That voice was ancient and cold, as if coming from the deepest origin of the universe, "The Tianji Record has chosen you, the last spark of the Chen family... but do you think you can escape my grasp?"

In the void, an invisible eye slowly opened, gazing upon that insignificant figure in the mortal world.

"No matter how you struggle, you are merely a piece on my chessboard. The outcome ten thousand years ago will not change..."

The voice gradually dissipated, leaving only endless coldness spreading through the night sky.

text.content:
However, Chen Ji knew nothing of all this. At this moment, he was immersed in the newly obtained bloodline inheritance.

He could clearly feel that his bloodline had become more concentrated than before. Though far from reaching the level of the ancestor, that power was slowly awakening and would one day fully bloom.

Moreover, he could sense an even closer connection between the Tianji Record and himself.

Perhaps... this incomplete Tianji Record truly has an inseparable connection with the Chen family. And he, as the last bloodline of the Chen family, is destined to bear the unfinished mission of the ancestor.

"Tianji Record..." he murmured softly, "You chose me, I will not disappoint you."

In the distance, a pale white glow spread across the horizon. A new day was about to begin.

At that moment, on the mountain path in the distance, a white figure was approaching quickly.

Chen Ji frowned slightly, turning to look—

It was a woman dressed in inner sect attire, graceful in form, with a cold and clear face. It was that inner sect senior fellow disciple who had always harbored suspicions about him—Su Qingyao.

"Chen Ji?" Su Qingyao stopped not far away, her brow furrowed, "Why are you here?"

Chen Ji's heart tightened, but he put on his usual timid expression: "Su... Su Senior Sister, I just couldn't sleep, so I came out for some fresh air..."

Su Qingyao's gaze lingered on him for a moment,似乎在搜寻什么. In the end, she sighed lightly.

"There are some abnormalities in the secret realm. The old sect master sent me to investigate." Her voice remained cold, "If you have nothing else, go back."

Chen Ji quickly nodded and, after a bow, turned to leave.

However, just as he turned, Su Qingyao's voice suddenly响起: "Wait."

Chen Ji paused, turning his head, his face carrying恰到好处的puzzled: "Does Su Senior Sister have any other instructions?"

Su Qingyao gazed at him, her eyes deep and complex. After a moment, she said softly: "Chen Ji, I don't know what you are hiding. But I want you to remember one thing—"

Her voice softened slightly, carrying a trace of不易察觉的concerned: "Whatever you are doing, be careful of the old sect master."

With that, she turned and left, leaving only a cold silhouette.

Chen Ji stood in place, watching the fading figure, his eyes flashing with complex light.

Su Qingyao... just how much do you know?

It seemed he needed to reassess this inner sect senior fellow disciple.
